complete_examples.text: See for instance, Cui [20] and Zhong [23] et al. studied the interfacial behavior of CRTS II under temperature by introducing the cohesive zone model to characterize the interface of track slab and CA mortar, then the thermal-deformation, stress and damage were examined.
As observed that the thermal deformation has an obvious influence on the vibration frequency of the track structure, especially the lower and medium frequencies, with the range of 20 Hz-75 Hz.
